article.title: On the sympatric spiders from the Baja California Peninsula: Descriptions of the males of Syspira longipes Simon and S. tigrina Simon (Araneae: Miturgidae), with new synonyms
article.citation: Valdez-Mondragón, Alejandro, Jiménez, Maria Luisa, Palacios-Cardiel, Carlos (2025): On the sympatric spiders from the Baja California Peninsula: Descriptions of the males of Syspira longipes Simon and S. tigrina Simon (Araneae: Miturgidae), with new synonyms. Zootaxa 5722 (3): 301-325.
article.locator: Bibliographic record for Zootaxa 5722 (3): 301-325; taxon-specific pages are recorded in each claim locator.

morphology.text: The taxonomic account describes reticulated carapace markings and light-grey coloration in living Syspira longipes, and provides male and female specimen descriptions with measurements and reported within-sample variation. These are account-level characters and specimen observations, not estimates of all species variation.
morphology.placeTimeScope: Species account on p. 303, with figures 1–30 and 65–66; morphology and measurements are limited to the specimens described in the 2025 treatment.
morphology.lifeStatus: The description distinguishes live coloration from preserved specimen descriptions; no population-wide life-status or variation inference is made.

ecology.text: The authors report Syspira longipes from xeric areas of the Baja California Peninsula and list several microhabitats, including bare soil, fallen wood, leaf litter, gravel, cobbles, above-ground vegetation, beach areas, and sites near oases. This records the treatment's literature-based habitat observations, not an exclusive or complete niche.
ecology.placeTimeScope: Natural-history account on p. 303; reported Baja California Peninsula microhabitats in the cited treatment and literature only.
ecology.lifeStatus: Wild habitat observations as reported by the authors; cultivated, escaped, and unobserved populations were not assessed.

morphology.text: The diagnosis describes a three-stripe dark carapace pattern and sand-colored living specimens of Syspira tigrina. This claim is restricted to those non-palpal characters; the diagnosis and description differ on embolus and cymbial-groove traits, which are not synthesized here.
morphology.placeTimeScope: Species account on p. 311, with figures 31–64 and 67–68; diagnosis-level characters in the 2025 treatment only.
morphology.lifeStatus: Live coloration is attributed to living specimens; broader life-stage, population, and geographic variation were not assessed.

ecology.text: The authors describe Syspira tigrina as mainly active at night and cite pitfall-trap collections at study locations where it represented up to 50% of the cursorial spiders collected. The percentage is a local, method-specific sample result, not a species-wide abundance estimate.
ecology.placeTimeScope: Natural-history account on p. 311; nocturnal activity and pitfall-trap result are limited to the locations and sampling context reported or cited by the treatment.
ecology.lifeStatus: Wild-origin pitfall-trap samples and author-reported activity; no captive or species-wide behavior inference is made.
